_readme: Copy to watchers.json. Each watcher checks for free; on_hit runs only when something new shows up.

watchers.name: meeting-recaps
watchers.query: from:(zoom OR fireflies OR otter) subject:(summary OR recap) newer_than:1d
watchers.on_hit: claude -p "Draft a follow-up email for each new meeting summary listed in the file at $WAKE_GATE_ITEMS. Drafts only, do not send."

watchers.name: invoices
watchers.on_hit: claude -p "Add each new invoice email listed in $WAKE_GATE_ITEMS to invoices.csv: date, sender, subject. Do not reply to anything."

watchers.name: scanned-docs
watchers.on_hit: claude -p "Summarize each new PDF listed in $WAKE_GATE_ITEMS into 5 bullets and save next to the file."
